Hi Logan / StellarEd procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really appreciated the thoughtful questions from your engineering and procurement leads. Per our conversation I wanted to summarize the procurement items Redwood needs to get the pilot stood up and to confirm which billing path you prefer.

Quick recap of what we attached:
- Redwood vendor packet (redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf) — includes company details, KYC checklist, contact points, and insurance cert summary.
- W-9 (W-9_RedwoodInference.pdf) — filled for US tax purposes; if you are an international entity we can provide W-8 instead.

Decision points we need from you:
1) Billing route: PO (net terms) vs corporate card vs AWS Marketplace (marketplace billed). You mentioned procurement usually issues POs; please confirm.
2) Vendor portal vs email onboarding: do you prefer a vendor portal invite (faster) or a paperwork packet returned via procurement email?
3) Banking details: we will provide an ACH/wire stub if PO + net terms are preferred.

Proposed next steps (if useful):
- You confirm billing route and preferred contact for vendor setup by EOD Thursday.
- Redwood will send a DocuSign vendor packet (or portal invite) and a sample invoice template for your AP team.
- Once W-9/W-8 and banking are confirmed, we can generate an invoice for the purchase order and start provisioning Dedicated trial capacity.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf; W-9_RedwoodInference.pdf; sample_invoice_template.xlsx

Thanks — looping in Karthik to support any technical procurement questions.

Best,

Laura — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from procurement: 

1) Legal/tax status: StellarEd is US-based (EIN on file). We'll need a W-9 for Redwood (good you attached that).
2) Billing route: Our standard for vendor pilots is a PO with net-30 payment terms, but the finance lead asked whether Redwood supports marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace) for later production purchases. For the pilot we can do PO.
3) Vendor portal: We prefer portal so AP can track onboarding, but our portal requires the vendor to accept standard terms — do you have a portal integration flow or a static packet?
4) Banking: provide ACH + wire details and a sample invoice (we need invoice line itemization for cost-center tagging).

If possible, can you confirm Redwood's standard net terms and whether you require any additional certificates (CYBER insurance, SOC2 report) for vendor activation?

Laura — forwarding quick recommended answers and what I can support from the ops side. I spoke to finance about the net terms and portal options. See my proposed replies below (feel free to copy into your reply to procurement):

-- Suggested client responses/information pack --
1) Taxes: The attached W-9 is correct for Redwood (we'll also produce an org chart and EIN on the vendor packet for KYC). If they were international we'd send W-8BEN-E instead.

2) Billing route: Recommend we accept PO for the pilot (Net 30). For customers who prefer Marketplace later, we support AWS Marketplace for subscription purchases (we can provide pricing parity docs if needed). For now, agree to PO and note marketplace as future option.

3) Vendor portal: We have two flows — (A) Portal invite: procurement completes structured form and AP automatically ingests vendor; (B) Email packet: they upload completed PDFs and AP manually processes. Portal is faster; for smaller pilots sometimes email is fine. If StellarEd's portal can ingest vendor via an email invite, we're happy to do that.

4) Certificates & compliance: Standard ask — we can share our SOC 2 Type II report and a cyber insurance summary. I'll attach the SOC 2 link and flag to Security to provide any more detailed artifacts if procurement requests them.

5) Banking & invoicing: I'll attach a sample invoice template (line itemized) and the ACH/wire stub. Finance confirms Net 30 standard for pilot contracts; larger enterprise deals can have negotiated terms.

Attachments to propose to client: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf; W-9_RedwoodInference.pdf; sample_invoice_template.xlsx

Let me know if you want me to jump on the call with Logan and procurement to walk through the portal flow — happy to take that on.

— Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
